name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
🧹 v3.6.0 — Cleanup wave 4: data-schema housekeeping

🗑 Legacy settings key removed — the deprecated hideDiagLogUi flag (superseded by showDiagLogUi back in 2.17.0) finished its deprecation ladder and is gone from the schema; old settings blobs — including those frozen inside sprint-history records — are cleaned automatically on read.

📦 Migration registry collapsed — 14 historical no-op migration steps merged into a single one; stored snapshots receive one SCHEMA_BUMP audit entry to 3.6.0 on first read.

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — old data migrates automatically on first read, no data loss.

🧹 v3.5.0 — Cleanup wave 3 (audit follow-up)

📏 React layer under the size ratchet — all 21 JSX views got LOC budgets in the architecture gates; the layer grew unchecked before.

⚡ Workflow rules parse settings once per event — guard and action now share a single parse of the settings blob (was two).

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss.

🧹 v3.4.0 — Cleanup wave 2 (audit follow-up)

🛡 One protective envelope for all POST bodies — every write endpoint now shares the same reject-and-filter preamble, so the anti-wipe protection is inherited by default.

⚡ Faster hot reads — archive counters on the Capacity and Release views no longer parse the whole archive blob on every load.

⏱ Work-day length from project settings — workflow time aggregation converts days/weeks using the configured hours-per-day (was a hardcoded 8h).

🔧 Internal — the tab router moved out of the core module; no behavior changes.

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss.

🧹 v3.3.0 — Spring cleaning (audit follow-up)

🛡 Malformed requests are rejected — the backend now answers 400 to corrupted request bodies instead of silently treating them as empty; the anti-wipe protection introduced in 3.2.1 becomes the default for every endpoint.

🧹 Dead code removed — unused modules, 88 unused translation keys across all 15 locales and phantom settings are gone; the app got lighter with zero behavior changes.

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss.

🎨 v3.2.2 — Gantt zoom switcher looks like buttons again

🔘 Day / Week / Month zoom — the switcher now renders as proper Ring UI buttons with a highlighted active scale; previously it looked like plain text and was easy to miss.

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss.

🩹 v3.2.1 — Stability patch

📊 Gantt state badges are back — the transition-history line («was … · N days ago») was clipped by the fixed row height, and on repeated tab visits badges could get stuck on «Loading…»; both fixed, plus the chart re-renders after a date drag.

🔒 Data-safety fixes — deleting or finishing a sprint-history record now always targets the right record; the historical sprint view is fully read-only (it could silently mutate the active sprint's composition); a working copy is discarded only after its commit is confirmed by the server; «New sprint» snapshots the outgoing planning sprint; malformed or truncated requests can no longer wipe releases, absences or capacity; project switching fully resets caches (field values, backlog filter, capacity, pending flushes).

🔔 Errors are visible — failed saves now show a red error toast instead of a neutral info message (or silence), and transient failures retry (drafts, permissions, language packs).

🌍 Timezone & input fixes — sprint dates no longer drift a day back for users west of Greenwich; decimal effort input («1.5») parses as hours; Escape in a dropdown no longer closes the whole settings form.

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss.

🚀 v3.2.0 — Gantt on a new engine + reporting charts

📊 Drag task dates on the Gantt — drag or resize a bar with the mouse; the new dates are written into the same planned dates the auto-forecast uses (editor rights required).

🔍 Day / Week / Month zoom with a today highlight and bar tooltips; state badges with transition history stay in the left column.

📈 Charts across the whole report catalog — progress tempo, hours by assignee, plan-vs-fact variance by role, aging zones, spillover stack, tech-debt and bug-tax hours.

⚙️ TTM terminal milestone policy — first close (default) or settled (last) close on reopen, plus a precise episode-based Cycle Time model.

🚀 v3.1.0 — Auto-forecast of task dates

📅 «Forecast dates» button — On the assignee-distribution level the planner now computes planned start/end dates for every assigned task: the assignee's sprint capacity (approved business capacity in the Full model, personal resource in Light) is spread across sprint days proportionally to each day's availability (production calendar, absences incl. partial days) with a useful-hours-per-day cap, and tasks are packed sequentially along the assignee's personal queue. Forecast writes into the same dates you edit by hand — Gantt, Excel export and sprint history pick them up as usual.

🔢 Personal task queue — A queue-position column with up/down arrows; swapping instantly repacks that assignee's forecast. Manual date corrections stay until you explicitly re-run the forecast (with an overwrite confirmation).

⚠️ Honest over-capacity — Tasks that don't fit the sprint capacity get no fake dates: they're flagged with an «over capacity» badge and a summary toast.

⚙️ Opt-in — «Auto-forecast dates» toggle in Planning modes (planning tier, off by default).

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss.

🚀 v3.0.0 — Operational reporting

📊 13 reports in two contours — Operational (A): aging with thresholds, progress to target states, WIP/Done slice, time-to-market (lead/team/cycle medians with norms and pause deduction), flow bottleneck & rework, workload by roles, plan vs fact with as-of estimates, backlog capacity, sprint spillover. Management (B): monthly roll-up of 5 metrics per system, tech debt, bug tax, «1000 small things».

📈 Charts & export — multi-line charts per system (vendored Recharts); export any report to XLSX or PDF (vendored pdfmake, Cyrillic-safe; truncation/incompleteness flagged in the file).

⏱ Run safety — configurable timeout backstop, Cancel button and rollback for long report runs.

⚙️ Reporting settings (admin tier) — aging thresholds, target states, TTM anchors & norms, pause markers, status flow, access groups per contour.

✨ v2.19.0 — Release-management & backlog polish

🔗 Release task link — A release now has an optional «Release task link» field: a URL to the release ticket in an external system. Set it in the create/edit dialog; it renders as a clickable link on the planned-release card and in the history spoiler, and in the .txt export. Non-http(s) values show as plain text, not a link.

📝 Notes on the release card — The planned-release card now shows both the patch note and the notes (notes were previously visible only in edit mode and in history).

📋 «In a sprint» backlog marker — In the backlog workspace, tasks already included in any sprint's composition (the current sprint or one from sprint history) are tagged with an «in a sprint» badge — so you don't add them twice and can see which epic tasks are already laid out. Works in both the by-role and tree views.

📊 State column in «Distribution by assignees» — The task table on the tab gained a read-only «State» column showing each task's current state (per the configured State field).

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss.

✨ v2.18.1 — Capacity tails (#53): archive + partial-day absence

⏱ Partial-day absence — When marking an absence you can now set «Partial day, h»: how many hours the person was away that day (e.g. 2h) instead of a whole day. Capacity is computed more precisely — exactly those hours are subtracted from the day's norm (capped at the day's working hours; an absence on a holiday still counts as 0h). Empty = full day; old absences without hours stay full-day (backward compatible).

🗄 Capacity archive — Capacity data piled up across every sprint and could hit the storage limit. Now, as the active store grows, the capacity of long-finished sprints (all but the current one, oldest by end date) auto-moves into a read-only «Archive»: a collapsed «Archive (N)» spoiler on the «Capacity» tab with lazy loading (sprint end date · people · total base). Active data no longer overflows.

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss.

✨ v2.18.0 — Capacity tails + release auto-tags

🗓 Global production calendar — On the «Capacity» tab, YouTrack global admins (Project Admin or System Admin role) get an «Upload to all projects» button: one CSV calendar is pushed to every project with the planner attached at once. Such admins also get full access to every planner action in any project without being added to permission groups (actions are still attributed to them, and the concurrent-editing protection is not weakened).

👥 «By persons» capacity view — A «By roles / By persons» toggle: the new view groups capacity by person (a spoiler per employee with total base hours and Σ load), with their roles inside sharing the same editable cells. Both groupings edit one model — edits show up in either view.

🏷 Release status auto-tags — Release-management settings («Releases» section) gained a «Task tag» column in the mapping table: on a release status change the chosen tag is applied to the composition tasks and the previous status's tag is removed; a task added to a release, or moved in from another, immediately gets the current status's tag. Only existing project tags are used (an auto-created tag would be private to its owner).

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss.

🩹 v2.17.1 — Patch: project-switch state hygiene

🧽 Sprint form no longer shows a stale sprint — switching to a project without sprints now clears the Name / Dates / Goal fields instead of keeping the previous project's values.

🔒 Full planner state reset on project switch — personal-planning / Gantt snapshots and the sprint slot revision are also reset, so a stale revision from another project can no longer accidentally slip past the concurrent-editing protection introduced in 2.17.0.

✨ v2.17.0 — Release management + production fixes

🚀 Release management — New «Planned releases» / «Release history» tabs: group project tasks into releases, walk them through statuses (with a preview and optional native State sync), a readiness traffic-light, an epic ▸ story ▸ task composition tree, patch notes, .txt export, and auto-archiving of old closed releases. Enable it in project settings; release-manager / release-engineer groups control who can do what.

🔒 Concurrent editing protection — Two users editing the same sprint no longer silently overwrite each other: the save that lost the race is rejected with a clear message instead of wiping the other person's work.

🐞 Assignee mapping fix — Per-role assignee assignments no longer leak between roles after refreshing from YouTrack (they could swap and get lost).

🐞 More fixes — The task-ID column fits 15 characters; «Refresh from task» updates mirror fields on excluded tasks too; the sprint picker label shows the clean sprint name; the diagnostic log is hidden by default (a settings toggle brings it back); empty date pickers open on the current month.

🐞 v2.16.6 — Parallel sprints + backlog scope

🔀 Plan two same-date sprints in parallel — Two planning sprints with the same dates in one project now keep their composition independently: switching between them in the «Current sprint» picker no longer wipes the tasks you picked into the other one (each sprint's composition is snapshotted per role on switch).

📋 Backlog scoped to the project — The backlog pool and the task-pick search/suggestions are now scoped to the selected project (in the global-menu planner they could pull tasks from every accessible project). The «By zones» view is regrouped by role — a spoiler per role, with the state shown as a sortable column (sort by ID / priority / state, per table).

🧭 Sprint Parameters on project switch — Picking a project in the header now always opens «Sprint Parameters» instead of the last-viewed node.

🎨 Consistent Ring buttons — The view toggle («By zones» / «Tree») and the «→ to sprint» buttons now render as proper Ring buttons.

🧹 v2.16.5 — Dead-code cleanup

Internal housekeeping: removed the dead Ring-Collapse bridge (orphaned after the settings two-pane migration, #22) and three deprecated backend validator aliases (deprecated since v1.6.0). The canonical validators and the vendored Ring Collapse are preserved. Runtime behavior is unchanged — a pure internal cleanup.

🛠 v2.16.4 — Backend decomposition

Internal refactor: the YouTrack issue-field logic (field / user-field lookups, field updates, assignee refresh) moved out of the backend core into a dedicated module, and a backend size-ratchet now guards the core from regrowing. The runtime behavior is unchanged — a pure internal refactor.

🐞 v2.16.3 — Planner fixes

🖊 Editor buttons — In the role cards, the «Pick tasks» button (and other editor buttons) could look disabled even though clicking still worked, when several role cards were expanded right after the planner opened. Editor rights are now applied to all role cards at once.

🔀 Edit the sprint you select — With two planning sprints at once, the sprint chosen in the «Current sprint» picker and the one actually being edited could diverge: the composition was read from the selected sprint's snapshot (read-only) while add/remove-task edits went to a different sprint — so added tasks didn't appear and row-delete didn't work. Selecting an unfinished sprint now loads it for editing (rebuilt from per-role history snapshots). Finished/allocated sprints keep the read-only / working-copy path.

📄 Composition pagination — The «‹ ›» arrows page through the composition again when viewing a finished/allocated (historical) sprint.

🎨 v2.16.2 — Backlog role-grid layout + menu icon

The «Pipeline zones» role grid in backlog settings now lays roles out in a tidy, dense grid when many roles are active. Previously, with all 9 roles enabled the checkboxes stretched to fill the cell and pushed their labels into a one-character-per-line mess — a shared field-width rule was wrongly stretching the checkboxes (the root cause, now excluded for checkboxes). Plus: the YouTrack main-menu item now shows the planner's brand icon instead of the default placeholder glyph.

🔧 v2.16.1 — Capacity tab visibility hotfix

A follow-up to 2.16.0: the «Capacity» tab (calendar, absences and personal-capacity calculation) now appears in the navigation again when the «Full» planning model is selected. A missing settings accessor meant the navigation node was never built, making the whole tab unreachable. Affects only the «Full» model; «Light»/«Simple» are unchanged.

✨ v2.16.0 — Full capacity mode + sprint-state fixes

🧮 Full capacity model — The planning model now offers a «Full» mode: the planner consumes the approved business capacity per role and per assignee — the role remainder, the «Available resources» field and the accordion header all read the approved capacity consistently.

🐞 Sprint-state cluster fix — Adding a fresh second role no longer triggers a false «Select a sprint» prompt; deleting the last role record of the active sprint now removes the sprint completely (active state, server snapshot and per-user draft), so it no longer lingers in the picker or reappears after a hard reload.

🧹 Under the hood — Removed duplicate i18n keys across all 15 locales (clean build).

🎨 v2.15.3 — Backlog settings polish

Fixed the «Pipeline zones» layout (role labels no longer overlap the row controls), «Pause tags» are now chosen from a searchable list of ALL instance tags (previously free-text, and the API returned at most ~42), and the settings option font size is now uniform.

🐞 v2.15.2 — Legacy settings fix

Projects first configured in an early plugin version could no longer save their settings — every save (including the silent auto-save on open) failed with «invalid_settings_structure». The deprecated «dev1c» functional role and its orphaned settings keys are now remapped to «devPlatform» on read (values preserved), so saving works again.

🐞 v2.15.1 — Settings state-picker fix

The «Stand-up assist» (done states), «State rollup» and «Backlog» settings pickers now load the list of available states as soon as you pick or change the «State» field — previously the list was fetched once when the form opened and the picker could stay empty.

✨ v2.15.0 — Backlog module (#21)

📋 Backlog workspace — A pre-planning phase before sprint planning: pull tracker tasks into a pool grouped by pipeline zones (state → role) or as an Epic ▸ Story ▸ Task tree, switch views, and filter with YouTrack query-assist.

🎯 Lay into sprint — Send a pooled task into the sprint's role composition (auto-suggested roles by zone mapping + manual edit); per-role load bar (demand vs role resource); «Needs estimate», «Carryover»/«Continuation» (from transition history) and «Paused» labels.

🚦 Fail-loud — Tasks in unmapped states aren't lost: an «Other» bucket plus a warning that lists the unmapped states to configure.

✨ What's new since v2.5.6

🔐 Settings access tiers — Project settings are now split into «Planning» and «Administration» groups. Workflow-rule configuration (DTA, cascade aggregation, container-work ban, State Rollup) and access-rights groups are editable only by the settings manager; a new «Planning settings manager» group lets you delegate planning settings (roles, fields, norms, modes) without granting workflow access.

🎭 Per-role sprint status — Sprint status is now tracked independently for each role: lowering one role's status (e.g. via the overlimit downgrade) no longer affects the others, per-role status badges update immediately, and the composition lock is per-role too.

🐞 History & planning fixes — The «Allocation» and «Assignee» columns are back in sprint-history records; sprint intro fields (name / dates / goal) now populate on a cold load; the «Reset draft» button reliably clears the server draft; the working-copy banner and indicator hide when no working copy is active.

♿ Accessibility — Sprint-history record headers are now keyboard-operable (Enter / Space) and announced as expandable buttons by screen readers; the pick-assignees toast no longer shows doubled punctuation. Button labels now match their spoken names — the «Pick assignees», «Calculate resource», «Refresh from task» and «Clear» buttons are announced by screen readers and recognized by voice input exactly as they read on screen (WCAG 2.5.3 «Label in Name»).

🛠 Under the hood — Widget source reorganized into architecture layers (domain / infra / pure / data / i18n) with automated fitness checks guarding the structure; the test suite moved to Node's built-in runner (node --test: unit + golden, no browser) with GitHub Actions CI and a CONTRIBUTING guide. The runtime bundle is byte-identical — a pure internal refactor. The personal-planning data model is now unified onto per-role history snapshots as the single source of truth, eliminating a latent keyed-vs-single form mismatch in persistence (no user-visible change).

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss. Existing project settings (roles, fields, manager group) are reused as-is.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), estimate and spent fields, planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
